description: After prepare_quote_request returns ready_to_submit=true for any supported insurance type (MRH, auto, health, loan, professional, etc.), render an interactive consent review within ChatGPT, without Acheel/Assurland redirects. Read-only: it never writes or delivers a lead. The user reviews and answers inside the LLM. The write tool requires separate authorization.

answers.description: Real questionnaire field IDs from get_quote_requirements, including structured address objects and arrays for multiple-choice.

insurance_type.description: One of the 21 supported verticals or a documented alias such as mrh, auto, pet, home.

name: render_quote_consent
